per_candidate.id: s2:Microlensing Constraints on Primordial Black Holes toward the Bulge Are Galactic, 2026-07-17

rationale: The papers 2203.04777 and 2405.14984 provide evidence regarding the abundance of black holes inferred from microlensing observations, contributing to the understanding of the mass distribution of black holes and their comparison to primordial black holes.
